description: English UI translations for script-rendered Stockholm essentials. Keep Spanish content and shared assets unchanged.

dictionary.Recorre Stortorget y luego aléjate por l: Explore Stortorget, then wander into the quieter side streets. Continue to Riddarholmen for waterfront views and a little more peace.
dictionary.Si no quieres pagar una visita guiada, e: Even without a paid guided tour, the exterior and waterfront views are worth a stop. Check access to the interior rooms and tower before you go.
dictionary.Historia, agua y mucha calma: History, water and a little tranquility
dictionary.Muchas estaciones muestran obras de arte: Many stations feature artworks, exposed rock and striking colors. T-Centralen, Stadion and Kungsträdgården each offer something different.
dictionary.La historia en pleno centro: History in the heart of the city
dictionary.El exterior del Palacio Real encaja muy: The Royal Palace exterior fits naturally into a walk through Gamla Stan. If historic interiors are not your thing, you may prefer to spend that time exploring the streets. Check tickets and opening hours first.
dictionary.Si solo vas a elegir un museo, considera: If you only visit one museum, consider making it the Vasa. Allow around two hours inside and combine it with a walk through Djurgården. Check opening times and ticket prices before setting off.
dictionary.Una pausa en pleno centro: A break in the heart of the city
dictionary.Una escapada real entre jardines: A royal escape among the gardens
dictionary.En la isla de Lovön, a las afueras de Es: On Lovön island, outside Stockholm, Drottningholm Palace combines Baroque architecture, historic gardens and a UNESCO World Heritage site. Plan it as a separate excursion from the city-center sights; access to the interiors and other areas varies by season.
dictionary.Pasear por Gamla Stan no requiere entrad: Walking through Gamla Stan is free.
dictionary.Entrada al museo; el precio varía por te: Museum admission is charged; prices vary by season.
dictionary.Pasear por la isla es gratuito; algunos: Walking around the island is free; some museums charge admission.
dictionary.Jardines y exterior gratuitos; visita gu: Gardens and exterior are free; guided interior tours cost extra.
dictionary.Pasear por el barrio es gratuito: Walking around the neighborhood is free.
dictionary.Mirador y paseo gratuitos: The viewpoint and walkway are free.
dictionary.Pasear por la isla es gratuito; la igles: Walking around the island is free; the church may charge admission.
dictionary.Necesitas billete de transporte público: You need a public transport ticket to visit the stations.
dictionary.Ferry público con billete; los cruceros: The public ferry requires a ticket; sightseeing cruises are separate.
dictionary.Entrada de pago para visitar el interior: Admission is charged for the interior; viewing the exterior is free.
dictionary.Entrada al museo al aire libre; tarifa v: Open-air museum admission is charged; prices vary by date.
dictionary.Exposiciones de pago; precio variable se: Exhibitions are ticketed; prices vary by date and exhibition.
dictionary.Pasear por los muelles es gratuito; las: Walking along the docks is free; boat excursions cost extra.
dictionary.Jardines exteriores gratuitos; acceso al: The outer gardens are free; palace interior admission is charged. Check the schedule.
dictionary.Merece la pena si ya estás en Gamla Stan: Worth a visit if you are already in Gamla Stan and want quiet waterfront views; optional if you have very little time.
dictionary.Recomendable si te gusta la fotografía y: Recommended if you enjoy photography and are interested in the current exhibition; optional if you are short on time.
dictionary.Depende del tiempo que tengas y de tus i: It depends on your available time and interests.
